reason: A local browser-based Markdown review plugin that lets users annotate documents with comments, replacement suggestions, and deletion suggestions, then exposes those annotations to the agent.

summaries.zh: 在本地浏览器中逐段审阅 Markdown 文档，支持添加评论、替换建议和删除建议，并将批注提供给智能体处理。
summaries.en: Review Markdown documents in a local browser with comments, replacement suggestions, and deletion suggestions that the agent can read and process.

capabilities: Reads Markdown files and browses directories on the local machine
Runs a local HTTP review server and serves rendered documents
Creates, updates, and deletes review annotations and persists plugin configuration
Provides model-facing tools for starting sessions, listing annotations, updating statuses, and stopping sessions
